title: Tensor comparison for independent derived localizations
statement: For a scheme X with a specified derived localization [def-pc-derived-category], let e be its comparison to the standard localization [def-pc-derived-pullback-across-universes]. For every two standard derived objects A,B, the inverse comparison identifies e.inverse(A tensor^L B) with e.inverse(A) tensor^L e.inverse(B), for the fixed K-flat derived tensors [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. No quasi-coherence, boundedness, or Noetherian hypotheses are required.

proof.text: The tensors in both localizations are the images of termwise tensor on K-flat replacements under the fixed construction [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Use the same replacements before either localization. The Qh comparison in [def-pc-derived-pullback-across-universes] identifies the images, and both functors invert the resolution quasi-isomorphisms. Their composites give the asserted isomorphism for arbitrary A and B. Equivalently, uncurry the tensor into a right Kan extension along Qh times Qh, conjugate both domain and codomain by the localization equivalences, and apply uniqueness of right Kan extensions. These operations require no boundedness or QCoh condition.

theorem derivedLocalization_tensorComparison (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (A B : @schemeDerivedCategory X (HasDerivedCategory.standard _)) :
    Nonempty ((schemeDerivedStandardEquivalence X).inverse.obj (A ⊗ B) ≅
      (schemeDerivedStandardEquivalence X).inverse.obj A ⊗
        (schemeDerivedStandardEquivalence X).inverse.obj B)
